experiences.title: Data Analyst
experiences.description:
Analyzed 2M+ healthcare and business records from 15+ data sources using SQL, Python, Power BI, and Excel to build reports, track KPIs, and support operational and business analysis.
Develop and maintain 18+ Power BI dashboards and recurring reports covering KPIs, business metrics, operational performance, trends, and data quality indicators, translating complex datasets into actionable insights and stakeholder-ready visualizations.
Partner with 20+ cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, define KPIs, validate business logic, and deliver scalable analytics and reporting solutions.
Perform data profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance across complex datasets; enforce data governance, data oversight, data controls, validation rules, standardization, and documentation.
Develop advanced SQL using joins, aggregations, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, views, and query optimization for data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis, reducing analysis time by 30%.
Support ETL/ELT, data integration, data modeling, data pipelines, and data warehousing using SQL and Python; apply data governance, metric governance, data lineage, quality checks, and validation controls.
Automate data preparation, validation, reporting, and analytical workflows using SQL and Python, reducing manual reporting effort by 21%; perform EDA, statistical, trend, forecasting, root-cause, and performance analysis
